views.rationale: AMZN's revenue growth may not be sustainable, and its percentage growth rates may decrease
BA's cost of sales as a percentage of Revenues increased in 2019 primarily due to the 737 MAX grounding

NVDA's gross margin increased 2.0% in 2020, driven by reduced inventory provisions and the sale of previously written-off components, while MSFT's gross margin increased 22% in 2020, driven by growth across each of its segments.

PG's gross margin increased 250 basis points to 51.4% of net sales in Q4 2020, while NEE's gross margin was 51.2% of net sales in Q4 2020, driven by a decline in Gaming, offset in part by growth in commercial cloud.

UNH's cash flows provided by operating activities increased in 2019, driven by higher net earnings as well as changes in working capital accounts, while PFE's growth in costs and expenses could adversely affect future results.
WMT's operating expenses as a percentage of net sales decreased 8 basis points, compared to XOM's lack of comparable metric.
XOM's discounted future net cash flows decreased by 38.6% in 2020.
